<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="primary" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1A73E9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6C92F4"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F2F3F7"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height=" thirty" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#24262B">9:41</text>
  <line x1="310" y1="16" x2="310" y2="20" stroke="#24262B" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="315" y1="13" x2="315" y2="20" stroke="#24262B" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="320" y1="10" x2="320" y2="20" stroke="#24262B" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="339" cy="16" r="3" fill="#24262B"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="16" x2="344" y2="16" stroke="#24262B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="357" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#24262B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="359" y="12" width="15" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#24262B"/>
  <rect x="380" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#24262B"/>

  <!-- App header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="56" x2="34" y2="56" stroke="#3F414E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="62" x2="34" y2="62" stroke="#3F414E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="68" x2="34" y2="68" stroke="#3F414E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="54" y="67" font-family="Inter, Arial" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#3F414E">circle</text>
  <circle cx="357" cy="61" r="16" fill="#E8EFFF"/>
  <circle cx="357" cy="57" r="5" fill="#447BFB"/>
  <ellipse cx="357" cy="67" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#447BFB"/>

  <!-- Error card shadow and card -->
  <rect x="29" y="157" width="332" height="414" rx="20" fill="#8385A34D" opacity="0.18"/>
  <rect x="29" y="153" width="332" height="414" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Wi-Fi-off illustration -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="246" r="58" fill="#E8EFFF"/>
  <path d="M157 225 Q195 193 233 225 M169 239 Q195 218 221 239 M181 252 Q195 242 209 252" fill="none" stroke="#066798" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="266" r="5" fill="#066798"/>
  <path d="M158 211 L232 281" fill="none" stroke="#3F414E" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <text x="195" y="347" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#3F414E">Connexion impossible</text>
  <text x="195" y="387" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">Vérifiez votre connexion Internet</text>
  <text x="195" y="414" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">puis réessayez.</text>

  <!-- Connection detail -->
  <circle cx="83" cy="459" r="5" fill="#FF9500"/>
  <text x="98" y="464" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#7E8494">Mode hors connexion activé</text>
  <line x1="62" y1="484" x2="328" y2="484" stroke="#D3D7E0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="513" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#A1A4B2">Vos données seront synchronisées plus tard</text>

  <!-- Retry button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="91" y="531" width="208" height="50" rx="12" fill="url(#primary)"/>
    <text x="195" y="563" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Réessayer</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#D6D9DD" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Accueil -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,794 49,786 59,794 59,806 39,806" fill="none" stroke="#7E8494" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="35,794 49,783 63,794" fill="none" stroke="#7E8494" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="49" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Avenir Next, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#7E8494">Accueil</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Explorer -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="795" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#7E8494" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="134" y1="802" x2="141" y2="809" stroke="#7E8494" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="127" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Avenir Next, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#7E8494">Explorer</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Partager -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="794" r="4" fill="#447BFB"/>
    <circle cx="184" cy="803" r="4" fill="#447BFB"/>
    <circle cx="206" cy="803" r="4" fill="#447BFB"/>
    <line x1="192" y1="796" x2="187" y2="801" stroke="#447BFB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="198" y1="796" x2="203" y2="801" stroke="#447BFB" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Avenir Next, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#447BFB">Partager</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Messages -->
  <g>
    <rect x="258" y="786" width="22" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#7E8494" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="263,802 263,807 269,802" fill="#7E8494"/>
    <circle cx="282" cy="786" r="4" fill="#FF9500"/>
    <text x="269" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Avenir Next, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#7E8494">Messages</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profil -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="341" cy="791" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#7E8494" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="341" cy="803" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#7E8494" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="341" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Avenir Next, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#7E8494">Profil</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="836" width="100" height="4" rx="2" fill="#24262B"/>
</svg>
